verdict.rationale: Paddle documents built-in automatic retries (up to seven retries over 30 days) for failed subscription payments, plus an optional Retain add-on with Tactical Retries, optimized dunning email notifications, and in-app retry forms — directly matching the story. Evidence is first-party docs only, with a caveat that Retain's advanced dunning can't be tested in sandbox. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of recovery email effectiveness and no community validation of actual dunning outcomes.
